deliverables: one independent cast audio mix per locale
locale SRT and VTT from that audio's measured timeline

video.master_fps_note: Existing assembly uses a 30 fps grid; 24 fps sources are converted without claiming extra motion detail.

subtitles.spoilers: do not display a reveal before it is spoken or seen

animation.shot_rule: one clear action and one camera intention per generated source
animation.editing: planned cuts may use 2 to 8 seconds of an eight-second source; measure against recorded dialogue
animation.identity: approved base facial identity; named shot costume and age states
continuity: same light and exposure across adjacent shots
performance: no frozen talking portrait used as completed animation
animation.dialogue: Use reaction shots, over-shoulder framing and object inserts where full lip sync is not verified. Visible mouth close-ups require separate synchronization acceptance; no claim of automatic lip-sync support.
animation.text: Plot-critical labels and numbers need separately checked graphics composited onto a motion shot; image-model text is not trusted as evidence. CC dialogue stays separate.

audio.speaker_id: fixed across episodes and later languages
audio.mix_note: Use the existing measured two-pass mix and verify quiet speech on speakers and headphones. These are internal mastering targets, not a platform guarantee.
localization: never reuse the full Chinese mix under foreign voices
keep sound effects and music free of Chinese speech
shorten wording before excessive speech acceleration
retime CC from each accepted voice track
preserve line and speaker ids through revisions

quality_sequence: one representative pilot with dialogue, action and plot-critical prop
repair identity, animation, pronunciation and sound issues
freeze approved style and voice references

controllable_work: title and thumbnail promise match the first thirty seconds
genre-specific action rather than repeating document exposition
audience_goal.measurement: Compare title/thumbnail variants and audience retention against the channel's own baseline after sufficient impressions. Inspect dips and rewatch spikes in context; no invented universal CTR threshold.
